محمد بن عبد الله بن زرارة
عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن الأصم

notes: Two isnads, each opened by «حدثني أبي» with no «ح»: two groups, each writing its own names in full, so the tail is null
«حججت مع أبي عبد الله ... فقال يا ابن بكير»: the Imam is named inside the narrator's story and speaks, so he is the last link (owner ruling 5), kind imam_in_text in both groups
«أبي» is bare: the narrator's father, a relation link (rule 7); the saying is the same in both groups
